ValidationRule.description: If School Type is HS then Only HS Type of School Account should be Selected.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
OR(AND( ISPICKVAL( School_Type__c , 'High School'), NOT(ISBLANK( School__c)), School__r.RecordType.Name <> "Overseas School - HS"), AND(ISPICKVAL( School_Type__c , 'College'), NOT(ISBLANK( School__c)), School__r.RecordType.Name <> "Overseas School - CC" ), AND(ISPICKVAL( School_Type__c , 'University'), NOT(ISBLANK( School__c)), School__r.RecordType.Name <> "Overseas School - University"
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: School Name should be of School Type.
